composition_mismatch_note: Our corpus's composition (72/0.2/8/19% by frame count, clone-only VKITTI) diverges substantially from VDA's own published training mixture (~56/7/18/18%, from 0.31M/0.04M/0.1M/0.1M =~ 0.55M total, arXiv 2501.12375) -- far more TartanAir, far less VKITTI and IRS than VDA actually trained on (VKITTI's gap widens further once corrected to clone-only: our real VKITTI corpus is under 6% the size VDA's paper mixture implies). `data.sampling: "proportional"` (train.py) samples proportional to whatever frame_count is declared per source in the config, which defaults to matching THIS artifact's real on-disk counts, not VDA's paper ratios -- see provenance/plan_state.json's VAL-01 note for the open question this leaves for the VAL-01 configs.
